title: The Crown of the Sundered Sea
author: Wren Okonkwo
blurb: Astrid Yarrow, a thief who steals memories, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
